crowdsec.title: CrowdSec
crowdsec.help: CrowdSec watches the requests to the wiki and blocks addresses that scan or attack it. Here you see whether it runs, what it found and whom it blocks. You can lift a block and allow addresses that CrowdSec must never block.
crowdsec.other_site: CrowdSec protects the whole installation. Manage it on the main site.
crowdsec.status.off: CrowdSec is not set up. Enter the address of the Local API and the password of the machine below.
crowdsec.status.ok: Connected as machine {machine}. Blocked addresses now: {count}.
crowdsec.url_help: With the bundled setup: http://crowdsec:8080. The wiki only talks to this address.
crowdsec.machine_help: The wiki signs in to CrowdSec under this name. Default: ewiki.
crowdsec.password_help: The bundled setup creates it and registers the machine itself. Otherwise register it with cscli machines add.
crowdsec.blocked_none: CrowdSec blocks no address at the moment.
crowdsec.unblock_confirm: Lift the block of {address}? CrowdSec blocks the address again if it attacks again.
crowdsec.allowed_help: CrowdSec never blocks these addresses and networks, for example your office or a monitoring service. Their current blocks are lifted.
crowdsec.allowed_no_exchange: The list cannot be changed here: the exchange folder with CrowdSec is not set up. The bundled setup sets it up for you.
crowdsec.allowed_pending: CrowdSec has not applied all changes yet. That takes a few seconds.
crowdsec.allowed_unknown: Whether CrowdSec applies the list is unknown: {error}
crowdsec.allow_value_help: For example 192.0.2.10 or 192.0.2.0/24. Networks are at most /8 (IPv4) or /24 (IPv6).
crowdsec.allow_note_help: Optional. For example, who uses the address.
perm.security.crowdsec.view_help: See whether CrowdSec runs, its alerts, the blocked and the allowed addresses.
perm.security.crowdsec.manage_help: Lift blocks and change the allowed addresses of CrowdSec (includes viewing). Only in a fresh browser session or on the server.
limit.security.crowdsec.list_max.help: At most this many alerts or blocks are read from CrowdSec at once.
limit.security.crowdsec.allowlist_max.he: At most this many addresses and networks can be allowed.
